about: Matthew tells the good news of Jesus, the King God promised long ago.

pages.title: The Wise Men
pages.scene: Wise men on camels following a star
pages.text: When Jesus was born, wise men from the east saw a special star. They followed it a long way. The star stopped over the house where young Jesus was. The wise men bowed down and gave Him gold, frankincense and myrrh.
pages.lesson: Jesus is the King, worth our best gifts.

pages.title: Jesus Is Baptized
pages.scene: Jesus in the river with a dove coming down
pages.text: John the Baptist was baptizing people in the Jordan River. Jesus came to be baptized too. When He came up out of the water, the Holy Spirit came down like a dove. A voice from heaven said, "This is my Son, whom I love."

pages.title: The Sermon on the Mount
pages.scene: Jesus teaching a crowd on a hillside
pages.text: Jesus sat on a hill and taught the crowds. "Happy are the gentle and the peacemakers. Love your enemies. Don't worry: God feeds the birds and dresses the flowers, and He will take care of you. Treat others the way you want to be treated."
pages.lesson: Treat others the way you want to be treated.

pages.title: The Wise Builder
pages.scene: One house on rock and one on sand in the rain
pages.text: Jesus said, "A wise man built his house on the rock. The rain came, but the house stood strong. A foolish man built his house on the sand. When the storm came, it fell down flat! When you listen to me and obey, you are like the wise builder."
pages.lesson: Build your life on Jesus' words.

pages.title: Walking on Water
pages.scene: Jesus holding Peter's hand on the waves
pages.text: One windy night the disciples were in a boat. Jesus came walking on the water! Peter said, "Lord, let me come too!" Peter walked on the water, but then he looked at the waves and began to sink. Jesus took his hand and said, "Why did you doubt?"

pages.title: Go and Tell
pages.scene: Jesus sending His friends out from a mountain
pages.text: After Jesus rose from the dead, He met His friends on a mountain. He said, "Go to all the world. Teach people to follow me and baptize them. And remember, I am with you always, to the very end."
